faq.title: Quick answers to your questions.
faq.lead: The most common questions about how I work, pricing, project timelines, and what happens after launch.
faq.cta: Have a different question? Email me

q1.q: How long does it take to build a site?
q1.a: 3-5 weeks for a standard site. 6-10 for complex projects (e-commerce, integrations, dashboards). Exact timeline in the discovery call.

q2.q: How much does a site cost?
q2.a: Priced to the value it creates, not by the hour. We talk first, I learn your business, then you get one clear number that doesn't move later. If it sounds steep, the next answer has the math.

q2b.q: Why does it cost what it costs?
q2b.a: Because it saves you €3,000-5,000 a year. An SEO specialist runs €1,500/month, a developer €1,200, an analytics manager €800. I cover all of it, you own everything, and the system runs on its own. You pay once and the profit keeps coming.

q3.a: React, Next.js, TypeScript for frontend. Cloudflare for enterprise security (DDoS, WAF, SSL). Server-side tracking + NIS2 compliance included.

q4.a: The first 30 days after launch are on me. After that, an optional monthly package covers monitoring, backups and tweaks, so you never check uptime yourself.

q5.q: How does the collaboration process work?
q5.a: Discovery → Audit → Design (Figma, 2 feedback rounds) → Build (with live staging for you) → Launch → Owning the metrics (monthly report).

q6.a: You do. After final payment: source code, Figma files, documentation, Git access. Zero lock-in.

q7.q: How do you handle hosting and security?
q7.a: I configure Cloudflare (DDoS, WAF, automatic SSL) + recommend hosting that fits the project. Backup, uptime monitoring and incident alerts — included.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro_body: The alcaziurobert.ro site is operated by Alcaziu Robert, individual, residing in Romania. This policy explains what data I collect when you visit the site or contact me, how I use it, and your rights under GDPR (EU Regulation 2016/679).
privacy.data_body: Identification and contact data: name, email address, phone number, and any other information you choose to share voluntarily. Commercial inquiry data: project type, estimated budget, and any files or information sent through the contact form or by email. Technical and usage data: IP address, session identifiers, browser and device information, pages visited, traffic source, and consent preferences. Data collected through cookies and similar technologies, only to the extent these are activated according to your choice.
privacy.source_body: I normally collect data directly from you, when you fill out the contact form or send me an email. Some technical data is generated automatically by your browser, by the infrastructure running the site (Cloudflare, Vercel), or by third-party providers activated only based on your consent.
privacy.purpose_body: To respond to your requests and provide information about my services. Basis: pre-contractual steps at your request and legitimate interest. To operate, secure, and administer the site, including preventing abuse, debugging, and technical monitoring. Basis: legitimate interest. To measure traffic and improve site performance through analytics tools. Basis: your consent, when required. To comply with tax, accounting, or other applicable legal obligations. Basis: legal obligation. For defending or exercising my rights in case of disputes or claims. Basis: legitimate interest. I currently do not use marketing or remarketing tags; if I decide to add them in the future, I will request your prior consent through a cookie banner.
privacy.refusal_body: You have no general legal obligation to provide your data. However, if you don't send me the minimum necessary data (name, email, phone), I won't be able to respond to your request or discuss a potential project.
privacy.recipients_body: I may disclose data, strictly to the extent necessary, to providers who help me operate the site: Cloudflare (CDN, security, and privacy-friendly cookieless analytics), Vercel (hosting and serverless functions for the contact form), and the email provider used for SMTP on my own domain. Data may also be disclosed to consultants, accountants, lawyers, public authorities, or courts, if required by law or necessary for defending my rights.
privacy.transfers_body: Some services used (such as Cloudflare and Vercel) are based in the United States, which may involve data transfers outside the European Economic Area. For these transfers, I rely on mechanisms recognized by GDPR, such as Standard Contractual Clauses (SCC) or other adequate safeguards offered by those providers through Data Processing Agreements (DPA).
privacy.storage_body: Commercial inquiry and contact form data: up to 24 months from the last relevant interaction, unless a contractual relationship or a longer legal retention obligation arises. Data needed for invoicing or accounting (in case of subsequent collaboration): for the duration required by applicable tax legislation (generally 10 years). Technical data and security logs: for limited periods, proportional to security and maintenance purposes (usually up to 12 months). Cookie preferences: as described in the Cookie Policy or according to browser settings.
privacy.rights_body: Under GDPR, you have the following rights: right of access to your data, right to rectification, right to erasure, right to restriction of processing, right to object (including to processing based on legitimate interest), right to data portability, right to withdraw your consent at any time without affecting the lawfulness of processing prior to withdrawal, and the right to lodge a complaint with the Romanian National Supervisory Authority for Personal Data Processing (ANSPDCP). To exercise these rights, write to contact@alcaziurobert.ro. I respond within a maximum of 30 days.
privacy.cookies_body: I use strictly necessary cookies for site functionality (session, language preference). For analytics I use Cloudflare Analytics, a tool that measures traffic without cookies and without personally identifiable data, so without requiring your consent. If I activate analytical, functional, or marketing cookies in the future, you will see a consent banner before they are set.
privacy.security_body: I apply reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect data against unauthorized access, loss, alteration, or unpermitted disclosure: TLS-encrypted transmission, Cloudflare infrastructure with WAF and DDoS protection, regular backups. However, no online system can guarantee absolute security.
privacy.changes_body: I may periodically update this policy to reflect legislative, operational, or technical changes. The version published on the site is the version applicable on the date of consultation. I encourage you to check it periodically.
privacy.contact_body: For any request related to data protection or exercising your rights, write to contact@alcaziurobert.ro.
